facts: A Border Collie named Chaser has learned the names of 1,022 toys, and can retrieve each by name.
The best age to bring a puppy home is 8 to 12 weeks.
Max, Jake, Maggie and Molly are the most popular dog names.
The tallest living dog is a Great Dane named Zeus, who measured 44 inches at the shoulder.
The world's smallest dog was a Chihuahua named Miracle Milly, who weighed only 1.1 pounds.
